name: discord-web-auto-quest-reimagined
description: A reimagined Discord web auto quest extension.

scripts.build:chrome: npm run build && npm run build:manifest -- --use chrome
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build && npm run build:manifest -- --use firefox
scripts.build:prod: npm run typecheck && tsx scripts/build.ts --production && npm run build:manifest
scripts.build:chrome:prod: npm run typecheck && tsx scripts/build.ts --production && npm run build:manifest -- --minify --use chrome
scripts.build:firefox:prod: npm run typecheck && tsx scripts/build.ts --production && npm run build:manifest -- --minify --use firefox

author: Nick Aidil (https://github.com/nvckai)
